title: 17.10. Kusalattika, Sekkhattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Kusalaṁ sekkhaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo nasekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Dve mūlāni.) Hetuyā cha, adhipatiyā cha …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate cha.
Abyākataṁ asekkhaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakusalo naasekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Abyākataṁ nevasekkhanāsekkhaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā naabyākato nanevasekkhanāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā pañca …pe… āsevane tīṇi …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate pañca.
